name: Betem Wireless Broadband
summary: Brisbane wireless broadband ISP (Betem Pty Ltd); active mid-2000s, defunct by 2007.

events.details: Wireless broadband; earliest Wayback capture 12 Jan 2005 (betem.com.au). Founding may predate the archive.
Defunct; last Wayback capture 2 May 2007 (betem.com.au), no captures after.
ABN 40 106 072 500 previously cited fails the ABN checksum and returns no ABR record (54 106 072 500 for the same ACN digits also returns none); the legal entity behind Betem Pty Ltd is unverified.
